**[@fig-normal2mci]** | **normal2mci exhibits inverse correlations with other transitions.** **A.** Scatter plots demonstrating correlation analyses between prevalent dementia effect sizes and the effect sizes of three transitions: normal2incid, mci2incid, and normal2mci. **B.** Correlation analyses between mci2incid transition and three transitions: prevalent dementia, normal2incid, and normal2mci. Each dot in **A** and **B** represents a differentially methylated position (DMP) meeting the significance threshold of [*P* < 1.0 × 10^−8^]{.rev}. **C.** Effect size correlations between prevalent dementia and normal2incid transition across three significance thresholds [(*P* < 1.0 × 10^−5^, 1.0 × 10^−6^, and 1.0 × 10^−7^)]{.rev}, demonstrating consistent positive correlations. The number of CpG sites at each threshold is indicated. **D.** Effect size correlations between prevalent dementia and normal2mci transition across identical significance thresholds, revealing consistent negative correlations. **E.** [Spearman correlation coefficients at 21 CpG selection thresholds, comparing normal2incid (red), mci2incid (green), and stable_mci (blue) against prevalent dementia and normal2mci transitions. The x-axis gives the threshold *t* on the −log~10~ *P* scale: *t* = 0 includes all 799,149 CpG sites (no *P*-value filter), and each step of 0.5 keeps only the CpG sites with *P* < 1.0 × 10^−*t*^ in at least one of the five group contrasts, up to *t* = 10 (95 CpG sites).]{.rev} **F.** Similar correlation analysis comparing prevalent dementia (red), mci2incid (green), and stable_mci (blue) against normal2incid and normal2mci transitions. Blue regression lines in panels **A**-**D** indicate the linear relationship between variables. Spearman correlation coefficients [(*r*) and their corresponding *P* values]{.rev} are shown in red text for each comparison. In panels **A**–**D**, a few CpG sites were removed as outliers. [Effect sizes are ΔM, the covariate-adjusted difference in mean M-value between a group and the stable normal group. *P* < 1.0 × 10^−300^ indicates a value below the double-precision machine limit.]{.rev}
